description: This file defines a React component for a comprehensive 'Multiverse Explorer' UI in a skill-path navigation app. It manages state for paths, bookmarks, role recommendations, and details, interacts with various backend APIs and local storage, and renders UI elements including path selection, role recommendations, and a mindmap view.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined gracefully.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRec
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from a recommendation object, with a fallback to generated ID.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRec
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a recommendation object.

methods.name: labelForPathType
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given path type.

methods.name: describePathType
methods.description: Provides a descriptive string for each path type.

methods.name: looksLikePathType
methods.description: Type guard to check if a string matches a valid MultiversePathType.

methods.name: pathMatchesFilters
methods.description: Filters paths based on the search query, industry, and skills.

methods.name: PathCard
methods.description: UI component representing a Path card with selection and bookmark toggling functionality.

methods.name: PathDetailPanel
methods.description: UI component displaying detailed info about a selected path, including steps and bookmarks.

methods.name: normalizeBackendBookmarksToLocal
methods.description: Transforms backend bookmark records into local bookmark objects, sorted by creation date.

methods.name: normalizeRecommendedRoles
methods.description: Transforms raw backend recommended role data into typed role objects, limited to 5.
